name: catboost_round_3
hypothesis: Lower tree complexity, controlled L2 and slower learning may improve original-feature CatBoost ranking and complement the preserved HGB models.
anchor: Exact frozen CatBoost spec from Candidate A; seed and Bayesian bootstrap parameters remain unchanged.
shortlist: Choose the highest-mean CatBoost passing the existing gain/stability gate against A's CatBoost. If none passes, stop without ensembles.
individual_acceptance: The shortlisted CatBoost must pass the existing gain/stability gate against the full Candidate A and have a positive paired customer bootstrap lower bound.
ensemble: Two replacements at most: shortlisted CatBoost 75% with A HGB 25%, and with the fixed shallow HGB 25%. No weight search. Require gain >= ensemble_min_gain over A and the strongest individual, stability vs A, and positive paired lower bounds vs A and strongest individual.
bootstrap_policy: 500 paired customer replicates from the protocol; evaluate uncertainty only after the corresponding development gain/stability gates.
notes: Six predeclared original-feature configurations, three expanding monthly folds. No early stopping, new seeds, tuning on November, or budget expansion. The slower trial preserves approximately iterations*learning_rate.
